rules.labels: Poppins uppercase, tracking-[4px] to tracking-[6px] with decorative dash '— OUR SERVICES'

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: background: rgba(212, 175, 120, 0.04); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(200, 164, 78, 0.15);
visual_enhancers.dividers: 1px solid rgba(200, 164, 78, 0.15) with diamond ◆ ornament in the center
visual_enhancers.overlays: Subtle grain/noise overlay on dark backgrounds. Ambient radial gold glow behind key elements.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: filter: brightness(0.95) saturate(1.1) contrast(1.05); border-radius: 12px to 20px;
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped CTAs, rounded-full, background: linear-gradient(135deg,#C8A44E,#D4B76A,#C8A44E), text: uppercase Poppins 13px-14px tracking-[1.5px], include arrow →

layouts.rhythm: Alternate between dark sections (bg-primary/bg-secondary) and warm cream sections (bg-cream/bg-cream-subtle) for visual rhythm
layouts.cards: 6 circular service category cards, 3 membership pricing cards (Gold highlighted POPULAR)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup @studio-freight/react-lenis or lenis for smooth scrolling.
Implement Framer Motion for scroll reveals, staggered reveals, and parallax.
Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for UI icons.
Use standard Tailwind classes mapped to CSS variables for the color system.
Create a global layout wrapper with the noise overlay and ambient radial glow.
For horizontal drag-scroll in 'Signature Treatments', use framer-motion drag='x' with dragConstraints.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards for marketing sections; build custom HTML/Tailwind components to support glassmorphism and gold borders.
Implement the 'diamond ◆' divider using an ::after/::before pseudo-element or a custom SVG.
Alternate sections with dark vs. warm cream backgrounds as explicitly requested.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive and key informational elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (20px blur) as per guidelines.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use generous spacing (p-12 to p-24) to establish a premium luxury feel.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive and key informational elements.
